items.headline: Raiola's 3 TDs help Oregon rally to beat No. 20 Northwestern
items.description: Dylan Raiola completed 22 of 31 passes for 336 yards and three touchdowns to help Oregon rally to beat No. 20 Northwestern 34-26 on Saturday.

items.headline: Northwestern safety Jon Jon Stevens exits loss with upper-body injury
items.description: Northwestern safety Jon Jon Stevens was carted off the field in the third quarter of the Wildcats' 34-26 loss at Oregon on Saturday after delivering a hard blow on a tackle, and the team later announced he was being evaluated for an upper-body injury.
